title: LimitedTrials+
description: This adds one use trail chests to your server. Makes it more difficulty to obtain the Mace or So People can't share trail chests
body:
this plugin adds a disapearing vaults after opening them... great for server that want the mace a little bit harder to obtain instead of using a mace limit plugin...


# **Features**
> ✅ Removes Vaults on Use
> 
> ✅ No Sharing Vaults
